subject: Discovery recap: gap heatmap + proposed trial launch
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai>; Procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: gap heatmap + proposed trial launch

Hi Samir / Veridian team — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and can move to a short trial quickly. I’ve captured the core pain points we heard, target goals, and a compact trial plan below. Please confirm (or correct) anything I’ve misunderstood.

Top pain points (what you told us)
- Frequent latency spikes on burst workloads (esp. >1k concurrent sessions) impacting customer-facing features
- Large variance in per-token cost across models and endpoints — makes forecasting hard for engineering and finance
- Need for auditable request/response logs and access controls to satisfy upcoming SOC 2 audit

Target outcomes for trial
- Reduce median inference latency for the targeted route to <200ms at p95 under your expected concurrency
- Demonstrate a 30–40% reduction in token cost through batching + caching + a quantized variant without materially degrading quality
- Provide a demonstrable audit log + access control handoff for your security team to validate

Proposed compact trial (2 weeks, scope & owners)
- Scope: run inference load against the Customer Support summarization route (priority use case) using a 10k prompt evaluation set we discussed
- Volume: up to 120k tokens/day simulated, with a controlled ramp (10%/day) to observe behavior under load
- Success metrics: p50/p95 latency, total token cost delta vs baseline, and prompt-level quality (ROUGE/semantic similarity sample)
- Owners:
  - Veridian: Samir Patel (project lead), Procurement (contract/PO)
  - Redwood: Markus Klein (engg lead), Ben Carter (ops & prompt evals), Marissa Cole (customer success / onboarding)
- Timeline (target):
  - Today (Apr 21): confirm scope & owners, share access procedure
  - Apr 22: Redwood sends trial environment + access instructions + trial prompt pack
  - Apr 25: environment provisioned, smoke test with Veridian engineers
  - Apr 28–May 9: controlled ramp and evaluation window
  - May 12: readout & next-step decision

Access/setup asks (what we need from Veridian)
- Short-term: provide a service account or S3 bucket with a sample of the 10k prompt set (or grant our service account read access)
- Networking: confirm whether IP allowlist or SSO is required for the trial environment
- Security: confirm any specific fields that must be redacted from logs for the SOC 2 preview

Attachments included: trial scope workbook (veridian_trial_scope.xlsx) and Redwood access instructions (redwood_access_instructions.md). I’ve also attached a PO template for Procurement to review.

Next steps
1) Samir / Procurement: confirm access route (service account vs file upload) and whether Procurement needs a DocuSign PO (I included a template).
2) Redwood (Ben/Marissa): will provision trial env and send credentials/instructions tomorrow.

Thanks — keen to get the trial started and demonstrate measurable gains quickly.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(attachment: veridian_trial_scope.xlsx [xlsx])
(attachment: redwood_access_instructions.md [md])

From: Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: gap heatmap + proposed trial launch

Markus — thanks for the write-up, this matches our notes well. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can expose the 10k prompt pack via an S3 bucket (we'll create a read-only presigned URL). Expected by EOD tomorrow when our data team finishes a quick scrub.
- Procurement has asked if Redwood can accept a standard PO via DocuSign. Please send the PO template to procurement@veridian.ai and I’ll route it.
- For the SOC 2 preview, our security team wants redaction of PII fields (name, email, phone) from logs — we can provide a sample schema.

One other asks: can Ben’s team include a small baseline run using our current endpoint for direct cost/latency comparison? That will help the finance team.

Samir
Samir Patel | Product Operations, Veridian Analytics
samir@veridian.ai
(Procurement contact: procurement@veridian.ai)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: gap heatmap + proposed trial launch

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 6:04 PM Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai> wrote:
> Markus — thanks for the write-up, this matches our notes well. A few clarifications from our side:
> - We can expose the 10k prompt pack via an S3 bucket ...

Thanks, Samir — we’ll do the baseline run and include it in the first readout. Quick tech notes from our side:

- Baseline: if you can share the current endpoint URL + a small sample key, we’ll run the same prompt pack against your endpoint and our trial env and produce p50/p95 latency + per-token cost numbers.
- Prompt set: we'll run an initial qualitative eval (100-sample stratified) using semantic similarity + pairwise human checks (Marissa will coordinate the human evals).
- Networking & access: we can accept either a presigned S3 URL for the prompt pack or SSO — presigned URL is fastest. For the trial environment we'll create temporary keys and recommend IP allowlist if you want stricter controls.

Action items from Redwood (we’ll do these tomorrow):
1) Provision trial env and create temporary API keys + send redwood_access_instructions.md
2) Run baseline against your provided endpoint once we have a sample key
3) Share a short dashboard (read-only) to track latency/cost during the ramp

Ben Carter
Senior Infrastructure PM, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(attachment: po_template.docx [docx])

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@veridian.ai>, Procurement <procurement@veridian.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: gap heatmap + proposed trial launch

Thanks Samir — that plan works. Two quick logistics items before we kick off tomorrow:

1) Samir: please share the presigned S3 URL when available (or add redwood-trials@redwood.ai with read access).
2) Procurement: we prefer DocuSign for the PO. Samir — cc’ing procurement per your note. Procurement team, the PO template is attached; if you prefer a different format tell us and we’ll adapt.

I’m scheduling a 30-min smoke-test call for Apr 25 10:00 PT to validate provisioning and run the baseline with your engineers. Invite forthcoming.

Final next steps (we’ll execute tomorrow Apr 22):
- Redwood: send trial environment + temp keys + instructions; run baseline once you supply endpoint/sample key
- Veridian: provide prompt pack (S3 presigned) and any redaction schema for SOC 2 preview
- Procurement: confirm DocuSign PO path and initial PO quantity; if everything looks good we’ll start the trial immediately after smoke test

Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
